films.title: LSD: Love, Sex aur Dhokha
films.overview: A video camcorder, a store security camera, and concealed cameras candidly expose lives in three loosely linked tales.

films.title: Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!
films.overview: Lovinder Singh, a thief now in custody and facing trial, reflects on his life of crime while the press reflect on how he managed to get away with so much before being arrested.

films.title: Khosla Ka Ghosla!
films.overview: Kamal Khosla's (Anupam Kher) peaceful retirement plan doesn't go as planned when his land is grabbed by a land shark, Khurana (Boman Irani). In a bid to retrieve their land, the dysfunctional family hatches a clever plan to con Khurana with the help of their friends.

films.title: Shanghai
films.overview: Prime leader of a campaign against a big government project is killed in what appears to be a road accident. An IAS officer is ordered to probe the incident and the veils of falsehood begin to drop.

films.title: Bombay Talkies
films.overview: One hundred years of Hindi cinema is celebrated in four short stories showcasing the power of film.

films.title: Detective Byomkesh Bakshy!
films.overview: Byomkesh, fresh out of college, agrees to investigate the disappearance of Bhuvan, a chemist. Assisted by Bhuvan's son Ajit, Byomkesh links the case to a larger conspiracy that will unsettle Calcutta.

films.title: Lust Stories
films.overview: An anthology of four stories that sheds light on modern relationships from the viewpoint of the Indian woman.

films.title: Ghost Stories
films.overview: An anthology of four short horror tales.
